object.attr: stakeholder: a document traces only to itself and to the documents it derives from. A hand edit or a removed parent can leave such a link, which gets LINK_NOT_ALLOWED alone, whether its target exists or not. Cite TRACE's requirement here once it has an ID (review Q14, Q31, Q54).
object.description: If an outgoing link's target is in a document that is neither the link's own document nor a parent document of that document, Mellon shall report the validation error LINK_NOT_ALLOWED.
